scope: Reverify three previously reported M1 UI persistence issues and the memory-only reconnect boundary. No M2-M7 acceptance was performed.

test_summary.runner_exit_code_semantics: The external observation harness completed and emitted structured results; exit code zero does not mean all checks passed.

environment.browser: Installed Google Chrome, headless, controlled through project Playwright; browser version was not separately recorded.
environment.data: New temporary SQLite workspace outside the repository; only synthetic UI data.
environment.ui_start_command: bash scripts/node.sh npm --prefix apps/web run dev -- --port 5184
environment.authentication: Launcher-issued one-time code was captured only in process memory, passed through the browser fragment, and exchanged through the real bootstrap endpoint. No credentials were written to evidence.

steps: Bootstrap a fresh browser context and reset its temporary workspace to the empty UI session.
Explicitly load the synthetic course, select textbook, and expand two chapters.
Scroll the directory to 220 pixels and wait for the real server acknowledgment.
Switch to practice and back to textbook, then reload and read the persisted session.
Start from an acknowledged empty session.
Inject QuotaExceededError only for pending-ui localStorage writes and abort PUT requests to the workbench session endpoint.
Collapse the navigation panel and wait for the attempted save to fail.
Observe UI status, read the unchanged server session, and dispatch a cancellable beforeunload event to inspect the registered protection.

observations.visible_error: 保存失败：Failed to fetch。本地改动仍保留。重试连接

steps: Continue the preceding scenario while the unsaved navigation change remains only in memory.
Remove the injected PUT failure, leaving the localStorage quota failure in place.
Click the ordinary retry-connection button without choosing to discard local changes or use the server snapshot.
Observe the UI, the server state, and the cumulative PUT request count.
checks.cause_supported_by_read_only_source_revi: reconnect() selects a localStorage pending snapshot or the remote snapshot. When pending persistence failed, the unsaved live snapshot is not included in that selection and is replaced by remote data.
checks.required_followup: Preserve same-workspace unacknowledged live state and its base revision during normal reconnect; only an explicit server-selection action may replace it. Reverify after the implementation changes.

steps: Open two pages in one browser context against the same acknowledged workspace.
Abort API traffic while leaving the local UI server available.
In page A collapse navigation; in page B collapse Agent.
Reload both pages while API traffic remains unavailable and inspect their restored local candidates.
Continue the two-page candidate scenario and restore API availability.
Retry the connection in page A and wait for its real server acknowledgment.
Inspect remaining pending candidates and the explicit recovery UI.

evidence_limits: This is a structured record of real controlled observations, not a claim that the complete M1 acceptance suite passed.
The tested source was identified by file hashes rather than an implementation commit.
No screenshot, provider, worker, M2-M7 business, or learning-effectiveness acceptance was performed.
Only the subsequently authorized evidence JSON was added to the repository; application source, specification and progress state were left unchanged.
